item.title: Riverhead Man Charged with Killing Mother
item.description: A Riverhead man has been accused of killing his 63-year-old mother, dumping her body in a wooded area of Manorville. Curtis Trent Jr., 36, was arrested on Feb. 25 and charged with second-degree murder in Riverhead Town Justice Court in the death of Kathleen Harrison Trent. item.title: Language Awakening: Erasure & Shinnecock Resurgence of Long Island Algonquian
item.description: For decades, the Indigenous people of Long Island have worked hard at revitalizing Long Island Algonquian, their mother tongue which has no living fluent speakers. In 2017, Stony Brook University committed its resources to helping the effort by establishing the Algonquian Language Revitalization Project.
